name: GRIN精简结构复现
implementation: bidirectional mask-aware graph-message GRU reconstruction; compact structural reproduction, not official pretrained GRIN
source: Volve public daily arrays, artificial masking of known observed cells

split.policy: global chronological split; 14-record nonoverlapping windows stay within each split; train-only normalization/statistical adjacency

limitations: Compact reproduction rather than original authors checkpoint.
Natural missing cells have no ground truth; scores only use artificially held-out known observations.
Graph is statistical and does not prove injection/production connectivity.
Frozen held-out inference traces; browser does not run this Torch checkpoint live.
Professional rules must retain/flag physically invalid predictions; outputs are not silently clipped.
